description.text: Why study in DUFE 1.Brought up a huge number of international students from over 100 countries. 2.Located in west of Xinghai Park in Dalian city, which is a famous national scenic site. 3.DUFE emphasizes a students-centered educational approach. 4.Good climate with distinctively four seasons. 5.Convenient traffic. 6.A nationally designated Business Chinese Test center and a test center for the Chinese 7. Proficiency Test(HSK) Program Introduction Hospitality and tourism management degrees are administered by the Global Institute of Management & Economics (GIME). If you are a talented student graduating from an undergraduate course who is seeking a career in hospitality and tourism, this programme offers you an affordable study option in terms of tuition and living costs – with full access to world-class university facilities. Teaching Objective To integrate humanistic spirit and professional knowledge into university education, to train graduates with global competitiveness and with international perspectives, and to provide intellectual resources and support for management practice for the industry. Main Courses Brief Introduction of Tourism, Tourism Economics, Hotel Management Principle, Tourism Resources and Their Development, etc. Fee Structure Tuition fee: 58500RMB/year Duration 2.5 Years Degree Awarded Master's Degree Future Career This program includes theoretical, empirical and practical components to prepare candidates to work in public and private tourism and tourism related enterprises after graduation. Teaching Facilities The learning and teaching methods are a combination of lectures, seminars, tutorials, study tours and project-based assignments. Teacher Highlight Over 85% of the faculty lecturers are qualified with doctoral degrees

duration.text: The MSc Hospitality and Tourism Management at Dongbei University of Finance and Economics is a 2.5 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 185 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 9166 USD/per year ￥ 66000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of undergraduate school 5.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6.Certificate of English proficiency test IELTS or TOEFl will only be required if the applicant is not a native English speaker. You can click here to download the sample

requirements.text: 1.Successful completion of Undergraduate degree with good grades; 2.IELTS 5.5 or equivalent, with no specific band requirement;
